answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The ridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the inlet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
